scoring_justification: Result-level comparison against paper-reported formation energies and midgap states; recomputation from raw DFT artifacts is not feasible as the checker cannot re-run DFT.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported formation energies and midgap states for LaInO3 vacancies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Melt Growth and Physical Properties of Bulk LaInO3 Single Crystals', Phys. Status Solidi A 2021, 2100016; formation energies from text: 'structure with the oxygen vacancy O^{In} is most likely to form (-2.55 eV atom^{-1}) followed by O^{La} (-2.54 eV atom^{-1}), In (-2.50 eV atom^{-1}), and La (-2.44 eV atom^{-1})'; midgap states from Figure 14 caption and text: oxygen vacancies produce occupied midgap state, cation vacancies do not.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported numbers for the same vacancy types and same DFT method; they constitute the hidden gold the agent must reproduce.

outputs.description: Formation energies per atom for O^{In}, O^{La}, In, and La vacancies in LaInO3.
Presence of midgap states for each vacancy type.

output_contract.notes: Only the DFT defect supercell workflow is reproduced; the experimental crystal growth, characterization, and thermodynamic (FactSage) calculations are excluded.

steps.description: Compare formation energies to paper values within tolerance and check correct ordering
Check midgap state assignments match expected yes/no
